representation_chosen: frozen pydantic IdentityRegistrySnapshot holding the five canonically-ordered collections plus an explicit registry_version; text-in/text-out YAML serialization (sort_keys, canonical order, exact decimal strings); NO filesystem knowledge, NO config-tree files created (frozen docs' asset/venue/identity_registry.yaml layout is a deployment layout deferred until a seeded registry is authorized; nothing in I02 requires a file)

laws_measured.canonical_ordering_enforced: input order irrelevant; collections stored sorted by identity key
referential_integrity: VenueInstrument.venue must be a registered venue
EconomicContract underlying/quote/settlement/(margin) must be registered assets
ContractInstance economic_contract_id must be a registered economic contract
ContractInstance venue must be a registered venue
ContractInstance settlement/(margin) must be registered assets
provider is NOT required to be a venue (directive §33)
laws_measured.no_overlapping_active_terms: same (provider, venue, native_symbol) with overlapping [valid_from, valid_to) intervals refused; adjacent intervals accepted (bloc_05/01 §17.3); no ambiguity state exists at I02 so refusal is the only fail-closed answer
laws_measured.no_wall_clock_defaults: no datetime.now/utcnow, no uuid/random/hashlib anywhere in identity sources
laws_measured.no_silent_overwrite: records are frozen; validate_registry_succession refuses same registry_version with conflicting canonical content and accepts identical republish (idempotent) or any new version
laws_measured.fingerprint_choice: canonical JSON bytes comparison instead of a stored hash: deterministic serialization IS the fingerprint; zero hashing machinery added
laws_measured.registry_versioning_law: v1 and v2 both loadable; updating truth = new version/snapshot, never in-place rewrite (bloc_05/01 §15, directive §20)
